question: Should Android canvas navigation fail closed to the bundled scaffold for loopback, unspecified-device, encoded/malformed http(s), and non-GET main-frame targets?
rationale: The patch is a focused security hardening, but it deliberately removes local canvas behaviors that may have worked before; repository policy treats fail-closed compatibility changes as maintainer-owned security and upgrade decisions.

options.title: Accept fail-closed hardening
options.body: Merge the PR with the explicit decision that local loopback and malformed canvas targets should fall back to the bundled scaffold.

options.title: Require redirect proof first
options.body: Ask for one more redacted Android emulator run showing a remote main-frame redirect to loopback being intercepted and reset to scaffold.

options.title: Preserve local canvas compatibility
options.body: Pause this PR and request a maintainer-approved local development allowlist or opt-in mode instead of unconditional blocking.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed hardening
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the explicit decision that local loopback and malformed canvas targets should fall back to the bundled scaffold.
